page.overview:
What is Pick-a-Brick?

Pick-a-Brick (also known as Pick & Build) is a part of the LEGO Shop; closely related to the LEGO Factory. It allows you to choose a precise part that you need and can purchase it. You can buy bricks online or at a local LEGO Store.

The LEGO Store offers an assortment of pieces. It also offers the ability to hand-pick these pieces. Each LEGO Store offers two cup sizes that can be filled. You can also take cups from previous purchases and have them refilled there.

Due to the COVID-19 pandemic, the Pick-a-Brick cups in most stores are filled by staff. For this reason, the Pick-a-Brick selection is often presented in the LEGO Store.

A minifigure designer is also available at LEGO Stores, allowing buyers to create a custom minifigure from a limited pool of pieces.
